cells: FRAMEWORK CONTRACT FOR THE SUPPLY OF GEOSPATIAL PRODUCTS FOR THE COPERNICUS SECURITY SERVICE COMPONENT ON SUPPORT TO EU EXTERNAL AND SECURITY ACTIONS

The objective of this call for tenders is to award a service framework contract to a single economic operator for the production and supply of geospatial products for the Copernicus security service component on support to EU external and security actions (‘the Copernicus SESA Service’).

The Satcen, as the manager and coordinator of the Copernicus SESA service, seeks to acquire services to provide rapid and on-demand geospatial products based on the analysis of satellite imagery and collateral data for the detection and monitoring of events or activities that may have implications for the EU and global security.
Such products include, inter alia, layers, maps and databases under different formats.
The estimated total value of the contract is 6,090,000.00 EUR, excluding VAT.
The framework contract is concluded for an initial period of 12 months, renewable 1 time for a period of 6 months.
The procurement documents are available for unrestricted and full direct access, free of charge, at:
Main CPV code: 71354100 Digital mapping services
